text: The maximum student number of a class 15, they form a group to practice Chinese. There are various course for the students with different Chinese level. Applicants could take the course which is suitable for yourself. Beginner: Intensive Reading, Chinese Listening, Spoken Chinese, Chinese Characters Elementary: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Spoken Chinese, Chinese Listening, Introduction to Chinese Culture Intermediate: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Newspapers-and-journals Reading, News Listening, Introduction to Chinese History Advanced: Intensive Reading, Extensive Reading, Newspapers-and-journals Reading, Practical Chinese Writing, Translation, Chinese Linguistics Features of Chinese language program 1) Classroom teaching: Two kinds of classes(mass class or one-to-one class)are offered. You can attend either one according to their levels of Chinese proficiency and their own wishes. 2) After-class assistance with Chinese learning: A Chinese tutor is available for any international student. 3) Flexible entry time: Each year has two chance of entry and registration in February and September respectively, or prompt entry upon the arrival of the international students at any time of the year.
